 the State.

The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No. 338 of 2024 dated 19.12.2024, under
Sections 376 Ipc, Police Station Iti, District Udham Singh Nagar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, both, the applicant and the victim came close to each other.
They are in sports.
Once the applicant spiked the drink of the victim and established physical relations with her.
He assured to marry the victim, but now he declined.

4. State to file objections within four weeks.
5.

6. In the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("the AO") concerned.

In addition to it, the applicant shall also comply with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
